description: A saved chart document, as the chart editor's save tools and autosave write it.

chartTreeNode.description: An item ({"name", "value"}) or a group ({"name", "children": [nodes]}, whose value is the sum of its items).

value.description: Items only: the amount, 0 or more.

children.description: Groups only: the nodes inside it (up to 6 levels in all).

color.description: CSS colour (default: the palette colour of its top-level group, lighter further in).

formatVersion.description: Version of the envelope for this kind; readers migrate older ones.

name.description: Display name, when it has one.

document.description: The chart (`ChartSpec`, as get_chart returns it in `spec`).

type.description: Chart type. streamgraph stacks areas symmetrically around a center baseline; slope joins each category from the first series (before) to the second (after); likert reads each category as a question and the series as answers from most negative to most positive; parliament draws the first series as seats; sunburst draws the grouped data (set_chart_tree) as rings, and a treemap with grouped data nests its groups; sankey draws the flows (set_chart_links); barrace reads categories as time points and series as names, and animates their ranking; choropleth shades the regions of a map, each category naming a region by code (FRA) or name (France).

xAxis.description: Category axis (or numeric x axis of scatter / bubble charts).

min.description: Fixed lower bound, or null for automatic.

max.description: Fixed upper bound, or null for automatic.

step.description: Fixed distance between ticks, or null for automatic.

format.description: How numbers are written on this axis or series.

decimals.description: Fixed decimals (default: what the ticks need).

currency.description: ISO currency code for style "currency", e.g. "EUR" (default USD).

code.description: Spreadsheet format code such as "#,##0.0,,\"M\"" or "0.0%"; wins over the other fields.

kind.description: Category axis only: "date" reads categories as dates and labels them by calendar steps.

scale.description: Value axes and the numeric x axis of scatter / bubble charts: "log" spaces ticks by powers of logBase (values of 0 or less are skipped; min and max must be above 0; not with percent stacking). "linear" or null is the default. Ignored on a category axis.

logBase.description: Base of a log axis, 2 to 1000 (default 10; null resets).

reverse.description: Run the axis the other way: values from the top down (or right to left), categories from the far end. Default false.

stacking.description: none, stacked, or percent (each category scaled to 100%).

curve.description: Line shape: linear, smooth or step.

points.description: Dots on line and area series.

dataLabels.description: Value labels on bars, points and slices.

labelPosition.description: Bar label position; auto drops labels that do not fit.

innerRadius.description: Donut hole as a fraction of the radius.

gapWidth.description: Space between bar groups as a fraction of the category (default 0.28).

overlap.description: Bar overlap within a group as a fraction of a bar (negative: a gap; default -0.12).

bins.description: Histogram bin count, or null for √n.

radarTicks.description: Radar: number of evenly spaced rings from the value axis min to max, or null for round-number rings (default null).

radarGraticule.description: Radar: draw rings as polygons through the spokes or as circles (default polygon).

note.description: A source or footnote written under the chart ("" for none).

highlight.description: Category labels and series names (or ids) to draw normally while the rest are muted; [] shows everything. highlight_chart checks the names.

value.description: Where the line crosses its axis, in data units.

label.description: Text written on it, e.g. "Target" (default none).

axis.description: Axis it is measured on: y (default) is the value axis, y2 the secondary value axis (needs a series there), x the numeric x axis of a scatter or bubble chart.

referenceLines.description: Replaces every reference line (targets, floors, averages across the plot). add_chart_reference_line adds one.

from.description: One end of the band on its axis, in data units.

to.description: The other end of the band, in data units (ends may come in either order).

label.description: Text written on it, e.g. "Target" (default none).

axis.description: Axis it is measured on: y (default) is the value axis, y2 the secondary value axis (needs a series there), x the numeric x axis of a scatter or bubble chart.

referenceBands.description: Replaces every reference band (target ranges across the plot). add_chart_reference_band adds one.

varyColors.description: A one-series bar, line, area or scatter chart colours each category from the palette, and its legend lists the categories (default false).

likertNeutral.description: Likert with an odd number of answers: split (default) puts the middle answer across the centre line; separate draws it in its own column on the right.

likertSort.description: Likert: order the questions by agreement (positive), by disagreement (negative) or as given (none, default).

parliamentArc.description: Parliament: sweep of the hemicycle in degrees (default 180).

parliamentMajority.description: Parliament: seats needed for a majority, drawn as a dashed line (null: half of the seats plus one).

parliamentLabel.description: Parliament: caption under the seat total ("" writes "seats").

sunburstLabel.description: Sunburst: caption under the total in the centre ("" for none).

sankeyLinkColor.description: Sankey: colour each flow by its source node (default), its target node, or grey.

map.description: Choropleth: the registered map to draw (list_chart_map_regions lists them; "europe" by default).

mapSteps.description: Choropleth: number of equal colour classes between the smallest and largest value (default 5).

mapThresholds.description: Choropleth: class breaks in ascending order, e.g. [100, 250, 500], used instead of mapSteps; [] goes back to equal classes.

raceTopN.description: Bar race: how many bars each moment shows (default 10).

sankeyNodes.description: Sankey: node names in the order to stack them within their columns (reorder to untangle crossing flows); nodes left out follow in the order the flows name them.

categories.description: Category labels along the x axis (or slice / time-point labels).

name.description: Series name (legend and data grid header).

values.description: One value per category, in category order (padded with gaps).

color.description: CSS colour, or null for the palette colour.

type.description: Draw this series as bar, line, area or scatter (a combo chart); null follows the chart type.

hidden.description: Hide the series (its data is kept).

axis.description: Value axis: secondary is drawn on the right with its own scale.

x.description: Numeric x per category, for scatter and bubble charts.

sizes.description: Bubble sizes per category (area is proportional to size).

pointColors.description: Colour per category (null keeps the series colour).

callouts.description: A label pinned to each point that matters, one per category (null: none); null removes them all. Bar, line, area and scatter charts. set_chart_callout sets one.

marker.description: Point marker shape for line, area and scatter series.

curve.description: Line shape for this series: linear, smooth or step.

dataLabels.description: Value labels for this series (null follows the chart).

format.description: How this series' labels are written (null follows the value axis).

decimals.description: Fixed decimals (default: what the ticks need).

currency.description: ISO currency code for style "currency", e.g. "EUR" (default USD).

code.description: Spreadsheet format code such as "#,##0.0,,\"M\"" or "0.0%"; wins over the other fields.

errorBars.description: Error bars along the value axis (bar, line, area and scatter series; on stacked charts they sit on the stack top). null removes them.

type.description: fixed: the same amount at every point; percent: a percentage of each value; stddev: value standard deviations of the series, drawn around the series mean (as Excel does); stderr: the standard error of the series at every point; custom: per-point plus / minus amounts.

value.description: Amount in data units for fixed (default 1), percent of each value for percent (default 5), number of standard deviations for stddev (default 1). Not for stderr or custom.

items.description: A number, numeric text ("1,200", "12%", "$40", "(3)") or null for a gap.

plus.description: custom only: amount above each point, one per category, in data units (0 or more; null for none).

items.description: A number, numeric text ("1,200", "12%", "$40", "(3)") or null for a gap.

minus.description: custom only: amount below each point, one per category (default: the plus amounts).

direction.description: both (default), plus (only above) or minus (only below).

xErrorBars.description: Error bars along the x axis (scatter and bubble charts with numeric x values; amounts in x units). null removes them.

type.description: fixed: the same amount at every point; percent: a percentage of each value; stddev: value standard deviations of the series, drawn around the series mean (as Excel does); stderr: the standard error of the series at every point; custom: per-point plus / minus amounts.

value.description: Amount in data units for fixed (default 1), percent of each value for percent (default 5), number of standard deviations for stddev (default 1). Not for stderr or custom.

items.description: A number, numeric text ("1,200", "12%", "$40", "(3)") or null for a gap.

plus.description: custom only: amount above each point, one per category, in data units (0 or more; null for none).

items.description: A number, numeric text ("1,200", "12%", "$40", "(3)") or null for a gap.

minus.description: custom only: amount below each point, one per category (default: the plus amounts).

direction.description: both (default), plus (only above) or minus (only below).

type.description: Fit: linear, exponential, logarithmic, power, polynomial or moving-average.

forward.description: Extend the line this many x units past the last point (default 0).

backward.description: Extend the line this many x units before the first point (default 0).

intercept.description: Force the fit through this y at x = 0 (linear, polynomial, exponential).

showEquation.description: Write the fitted equation on the chart.

trendlines.description: Fitted trendlines drawn over the series.

tree.description: Hierarchical nodes for treemap and sunburst charts.

source.description: Name of the node the flow leaves.

target.description: Name of the node it reaches (a different node; flows only go forwards, no loops).

links.description: Directed weighted links for sankey charts.
